reviews.text:
Wonderful care so far! We switched our senior chihuahua here and he has many preexisting problems for which he goes to specialists as well. Dr. Perone has been incredibly kind and practical in her approach. I appreciate her expertise, attention to detail, lack of pressure, responsiveness and the genuine care all the staff show my old buddy. Thank you everyone.

I have scheduled appointments to bring my two young cats here and know they are in good hands.
Thank you for the 5 Star review.

Been going to LVC for several years for both of my dogs. Everyone is always so kind, attentive, and personable. I rarely have to sit in the waiting area, which is really nice for my dog's comfort, especially my reactive/nervous dog. Getting an appt within a couple of days-a week is rarely an issue. Dr. Perone and Dr. Patten are both great; both provide excellent care and answer questions thoughtfully. I feel very reassured that my dogs are in good hands for any surgeries performed by Dr. Patten. All of the techs/assistants are wonderful as well!

The care that my precious fur baby receives at LVC is truly beyond words. From the moment I expressed my concerns, they made Abril’s well-being their top priority. They went above and beyond to make sure she was comfortable, cared for, and thoroughly evaluated. Their compassion and attention to detail meant so much to me, and their follow-up the very next day with her test results brought me such great relief. I am incredibly grateful for the love, care, and reassurance they continue to provide to my precious Abril. ❤️🐾I

Liberty is our new vet and from the moment we walked in everyone from the front desk to the doctors were so kind and friendly. For what my dog Cleo required the doctor gave a very detailed description of what to expect.  We are so excited to have Liberty as our new vet.

I got a same day appointment for my cat as a new patient.  Great experience.  The staff were very kind to my injured colony/farm cat and the vibes were so calm that he didn't even freak out like he usually does at other vets.  We will be regulars here moving forward since our other vet has sadly closed.

The staff is very friendly and so are the doctors. I always bring my little boy Simba up there to have his shots or trim his nails, they very friendly and very nice.also thanks for trimming his nails today Friday 7/8 did you polish them (ha ha)

Not only do we love Liberty Vet as our regular vet, but after using their emergency services yesterday we love them even more! I walked in a little worried, and by the time we walked out I had to thank them for making the experience such a breeze. Great staff, great service, always transparent and affordable. I truly cannot recommend Liberty Vet enough. So thankful for them!!
Thank you for the 5 star review
They’re professional, kind and very thorough
We’ve been going to LVC for 6+ years to take care of our 2 St Bernard’s!! We love how they care my dogs especially when both dogs have different personalities! Will always recommend LVC to others!
Thank you for the 5-Stars!
My dog is usually skiddish, but she loves everyone at Liberty Veterinary Clinic. They are kind to our dog and us.  We have been going there since 2017.
Thank you for the 5 stars

Every single person we encountered was delightful. I felt confident in the care Duchess received, and all of my questions were answered. I didn't feel pressured in any way and knew she was in great hands from the start. Thank you all!

Liberty Vet keeps getting better and better! We’ve had a great experience from the first visit three years ago, but our latest visit was even more seamless. Their detailed notes on my anxious dog, Sunny have made each subsequent visit easier. I can’t recommend this clinic highly enough!
Thank you for the 5 Stars!
Thank you for the 5 star-review!

The staff is amazing they cater to humans and your pets. Every time I visited with my cat or dog same experience very friendly and all my pet concerns are addressed which is very nice. It is very easy to get a quick appointment and the prices are not expensive which makes it even better.
The staff at Liberty was very kind and attentive, to both my cat and I. It was one of the best experiences I've had at a vet and I'd highly recommend them!

I just recently got my dog Rosie from the SPCA, and wanted to take her somewhere nearby for her first wellness visit.
The staff at Liberty Veterinary Clinic are very friendly and very knowledgeable and made me, and Rosie were very comfortable.
I certainly would recommend Liberty to friends for the pets needs and concerns.

I love this vet, I wouldn’t take my pets anywhere else, my cat is a bit feisty and they do a great job keeping calm and letting me help with handling, I find the prices very reasonable. Thank you for helping me take great care of Jon!
Needed an ultrasound for my Dog, Lily Rose.  Liberty treated her with utmost care.  No long wait in office.  Treated us royally.  Would recommend one hundred percent.  Easy to park, easy to  use.

I called to schedule an appointment and was told it would be $75. When I arrived, I was told I had to pay $115 because it was a same-day appointment—even though I specifically said I preferred to come the next day. There was absolutely no communication or transparency about the higher cost beforehand. This was not an urgent visit, so why would they hold me to come in the same day? On top of that, the one staff was very rude. Overall, a disappointing experience.

Dr. Patten and her staff are amazing. My cat, Callie, had her annual visit and she is not the happiest when visiting the Vet. Dr. Patten and her staff kept her calm and relaxed throughout the appointment and made sure she had a good experience.
Outstanding vet practice. Staff is friendly and the care is exceptional.
First time visit at Liberty Vet Clinic. The team was great. They were very patient, explained everything before they moved forward and treated my dog with the utmost care.

The veterinarian that I typically go to did not have an opening to see my dog and so I called LVC and they were able to see us right away.  The staff was super friendly and immediately took a liking to my dog. I was offered a refreshment when I came in which was nice. Dr. Adams was great!! Knowledgeable, good bed side manner, and a good communicator. Dr. Adams took the time to contact my normal vet for record history just to be thorough. They were upfront with the pricing and the pricing was reasonable. This morning they reached out to me to make sure my dog was OK. Needless to say I am impressed. Great job guys!!
Thank you for the 5 star review!

My cat was a former patient here. The staffs were nice, but I didn't like their system. When I bring in my cat, a tech usually takes her to the back right away for a blood draw. I always thought that was odd because I would like to talk to the vet first about my concerns so they can decide what labs to run. I have only been to 2 different practices, but the other place always did everything in the exam room when I'm present. I also didn't like how I had to wait in the exam room all by myself for 20-30 minutes not knowing what's happening to my baby. I'm sure they have their own reasoning, but it just wasn't a good fit for me and my cat.

Love coming here.  Everyone is always so kind and supportive. Also the team always is there to make sure my pets have the best care and have all that they need.  Appreciate everyone the care each time I come and visit!

I recently moved back to the Philadelphia area and had a immediate need with my sidekick Dawkins, a 7-year old Chocolate Labrador.  I was fortunately referred to the Clinic by a current employee I trusted (Alanna). Right away the welcoming receptionists, staff greet you and you feel like you are in the right place. I naturally turned to Dr. Patten and the LVC team for his annual check up and vaccination updating - it was an easy choice after my initial experience. Do not hesitate, I give them my full trust for the my best buddy. So can you.

Front staff is very friendly & organized, techs are very knowledgable (and will ensure you get answers from the vet if they don't have the answers themselves), vets are lovely and good at explaining. We've been with them for a few years, through the rescue of 3 pets and loss of 1. They work with us on our animals who are good at the vet, and those who are not. Very accommodating and willing to do extra for pets who have specific needs during visits. Great experience all around!
The staff was extremely friendly, caring, and attentive to my cat. Everything was explained to me in full, nothing held back. My cat has a trusted vet now!
Liberty Vet is amazing! I have been bringing my cat and dog here for the past year and they are always very helpful and caring. They always have appointments and are always willing to help.

My dog is reactive/nonfriendly, and Liberty Vet Clinic is beyond accommodating, kind, and knowledgeable when it comes to our situation. Night and day difference from the previous vet that would purposefully intimidate her. Staff is amazing, appointments have always been timely even with our higher needs dog. Thank you so much!! Can not recommend enough.
The staff and vets at Liberty are welcoming and friendly, always ready to answer any questions.  I highly recommend it!

Dr Perrone is awesome and the ladies that answer the phones are awesome as well. But be careful the bills are outrageous and be sure to check your receipts thoroughly for any charges not served. Always go to another vet for a second opinion also I’d like to note the one vet did miss a very high heart murmer on my newly rescued cat when I took him in for an exam. And be aware when you bring in a new pet and the pet is a senior be aware they won’t discuss what they are going to do when they say they’re taking your pet back for blood work and you think it’s just a cbc and then they slam you with an outrageously high bill stating they did a senior panel without discussing it first with you. 🐾

We’ve been bringing our dog here for years and have always had a great experience, however just this past week Liberty showed why it is truly an amazing place. This last week was an extremely scary time for us when our almost 8 year old dog was really sick for the first time. By husband was able to bring her in immediately same day. She saw Dr Adams who was so helpful - ordering all the right diagnostic testing to rule out emergencies but her symptoms were so vague it was really hard to figure out what was going on. Her blood tests and X-rays were all reassuring. The following day, the staff called to check in on her.  She was now exhibiting new symptoms which helped us narrow down the cause of her illness. Again, the receptionists were so helpful at getting us another appointment immediately with Dr Patton. I sobbed like a baby in the office because I was so scared and everyone was so gentle and understanding. Dr Patton was able to make a diagnosis and refer her to the proper specialists for further treatment. We cannot thank the staff and Drs Patton and Adams enough for how wonderful they all were during this very stressful time! From the receptionists, to MAs/nurses, to docs, they all are the absolute best. In the almost 8 years we’ve had our baby, we’ve never had a serious health scare like this and it was truly terrifying. They all were so kind, understanding, helpful - we can never thank them enough for always being there for us over the years! Not to mention, our dog is extremely anxious and fearful of people - but she handles going to the vet very well because she is always treated with so much love and kindness. Would highly recommend them to anyone.

The technicians were so kind and inviting, and the vet got right down to business. Was thorough and attentive with our cat. Everyone listened to our concerns and addressed each one. I definitely recommend

Liberty Vet is awesome!  I've been bringing my cat here for 4 years.  She was very sick when I first adopted her, and Liberty made time to see me several times in a short period.  (They also recommended emergency vets where I could visit at even shorter notice.)  You can tell the whole staff loves animals, and they have always been gentle and kind to my cat.  I've continued attending Liberty Vet for routine checkups and they are always happy to answer any questions I have.  You should bring your pet here!
Took my cat DeeDee there yesterday I noticed she had a worm near her anus. Everyone was so kind and caring I'm going to take my other critter there I am so glad I chose Liberty to care for my babies.

Everyone was very friendly and welcoming towards Lucky as a new patient. He received excellent care and thorough, comprehensive treatment. I am so happy to have found Liberty Veterinary Clinic for Lucky's pet needs.

They wouldn't renew our dogs Simpirica. He's been on Simpirica 2 years now. We went with Canada Vet and didn't need a prescription and was half the price. They also bled money out of us when our dog had diarrhea. Repeated a test 6 times and was negative 6 times. Plus vet office fees. And medication that didn't help because we found out it was normal puppy diarrhea from another vet lolllll 🤣 we were scammed by liberty unfortunately.

Very happy with the vet and other staff at Liberty. They all take the time to listen to my concerns and answer questions. My only criticism is that I would rather they perform minor treatments/exams like nail trimming, ear cleaning, expulsion of anal sacks and inoculations in the room with me so that I can see what they are doing and have some input in keeping Dexter calm and address any concerns that may have otherwise been forgotten.

Great staff, Dexter and I really like this practice.
Very friendly and professional staff.  Never a long wait time that minimizes stress levels for me and my pet !
Great location/parking and the team is kind and incredibly patient! I had a lot of questions for my pup and their communication and response times were excellent. Highly recommend!
Took excellent care of our puppy ravioli and Was able to schedule an appointment within 24 hours of calling
Thanks for the 5-Star review!
Great vet, would recommend to anyone with a dog. They're always very sweet and caring with our dog.
Quick and friendly service at an appropriate price. Great experience.
Heather, Thank you for the 5 star review!!

So grateful to have found this clinic during an emergency. My dog was hit by a car, and this place was the only one in the area that was open early in the morning. We got all the lab work and X-rays done in a matter of minutes. The staff were beyond supportive and helpful. Thank you so so much for your help.

The staff is fantastic, and I love how patient they are with Aspen, as she tends to be very nervous for visits. Everyone makes sure I have had the ability to ask any and all questions, and it has been the easiest place to get care for Aspen that I’ve ever been. Thank you for everything. You’re the best!

These guys are the greatest. So caring, so knowledgeable. They understand the bond between pet and owner, value and respect it. It’s infrequent to find professionals who care it seems even more for your dear pet than you do. Trust your dog, cat, iguana, whatever to these folks for the support and TLC they so generously provide.

The staff and doctor are very pleasant and welcoming.  They explain all issues and are very thorough.  They are very kind with my animals and treat them as if they were their own.  I would highly recommend this vet!

We have received excellent care and treatment for our Collie. The staff are great and obviously love working there, which is always a good sign.
The veterinarian that we have seen is very thorough, knowledgeable and kind, and made a great connection with our dog.
The clinic itself is spotless and there are no unseemly odors, which is impressive when considering that sick animals are being treated there all day long.
We love our dog and are extremely happy with knowing that she will be cared for by such a great group of people.
I highly recommend Liberty Veterinary Clinic to any other animal lovers!
Amazing veterinary clinic!!
Best vet clinic we have ever been to. No fuss, no wait, only excellent service from beginning to end—excuse me—nose to tail.

I can't recommend this clinic enough! Over the past year, they’ve provided exceptional care for my dog through a range of issues, always accommodating us in urgent situations. We’ve never had to wait too long. If you call ahead the receptionist can guide you about when to show up, and the doctors are consistently kind, patient, and thorough. The vet techs are truly top-notch—they’re the best I’ve encountered, making my dog feel calm and well cared for during every visit. As for pricing, I find their rates to be very reasonable, especially considering the high-quality care they provide. It’s absolutely worth it for the overall experience and peace of mind knowing my dog is in such good hands.

Riley and I just moved from out of town and Dr. Perone and team were wonderful from start to finish! They were considerate of Riley's needs and thoroughly explained everything. We were in and out but didn't feel rushed, would highly recommend!

My 1 year dog had heart issues, the site originally said to see a cardiologist. They told me it wasn’t too urgent. I ended up having to take her to the ER for emergency pacemaker surgery. Following the surgery, I requested the vet re wrap the bandage around my dogs neck. They refused and told me to go back to ER.

My husband and I have taken our dog, Franklin, here for 3 years. They have been the only practice Franklin has known. I cannot say enough how kind and patient the whole staff is. Franklin can be a little nervous going to the vet, and they always go above and beyond to make sure he's comfortable. We recently moved further away, and we make the drive for the quality of care. Thank you so much for everything, Liberty Vet Clinic!

Four years and 3 dogs in succession! Always wonderful service. Very helpful explanations of procedures. Kind -especially sensitive when doggie
reaches the end. 🫶 …

I have been taking my dog and cat here, as well as multiple foster dogs and cats, and my parents' pets. I love how I can actually get an appointment on the same day! They have openings when you need them. Soon. Their charges are SO reasonable compared to all the other vets I know in the area. They removed 12+ rotted teeth from my mom's 20 year old bichon rescue for $1500 whereas another long established vet nearby gave us an estimate of $4000. Dog lived another 4 healthy years and then they were beyond helpful with helping my elderly mom to make the decision to put her down once things got bad at the end. Who knew that dogs get dementia too. The vet tech Joe was so knowledgeable, kind and helpful with the difficult decision. Can't say enough good things about this place.
The nail clipping is only $20 btw. Gland expression is $26. I didn't know these services could be that affordable.
Front desk is great. Friendly and efficient.

My sister and I were recently at Liberty Vet clinic after making the tough decision to put down her beloved cat. It was an extremely hard and sad decision… and after her spending over 6k at a different vet to try and cure cancer in his foot. She was all out of funds and would have loved to have him put down at the home, but the money was all gone. This place was recommended and I can’t say enough about how caring and amazing this place is. They took us right back to the room and were so kind and caring and made Pluto’s transition peaceful! Thank you so much for that. My sister was so sad… and you made the experience one that was comfortable and caring… I now want to transfer all my pets to their care. I’m so grateful! If I could give 100 stars, I would.

Our 4 pets have been under the care of Liberty Vet since they opened.  Dr Patten, Dr Perrone and staff are exceptional.  Everyone truly cares about the well being of your pets. They treat them like they are their family. They are efficient, professional and take the time to explain all of your pets needs. We have had to unfortunately put 2 of our 4 dogs to rest in the past 3 years. Liberty Vet is so compasionate and caring during the difficult times as well as the good.  I wouldnt go anywhere else.  They are truly amazing.

I have been taking my dog here for over two years and they are always wonderful with him. He has a lot of vet anxiety and the entire team has been nothing but understanding and collaborative when it comes to the best care for him. Their service costs are fair and more than reasonable for the level of care they provide. They are prompt, professional, and kind to both humans and animals. I highly recommend them!

Liberty Veterinary Clinic has been a fantastic choice for my cat. The staff is incredibly kind, professional, and knowledgeable. They always take the time to answer all my questions.  Highly recommended!
Very nice staff but poor communicators. Our loss could have been avoided.
I loved the staff at Liberty--they were both competent and compassionate. I didn't have a long wait, and they were sure both my cat and I were comfortable!  Kudos!
As a retired medical professional I very much appreciate Dr.Patten’s care and skill as she cares for my pets. Her staff is always courteous and helpful. I very highly recommend Liberty Vet Clinic.

Best vet! Always takes great care of my pets and reassures me when I’m overly worried about something. They are attentive and take their time, always accommodating and flexible and provides genuine good care. They are priced fairly and always try their best to work within my budget. I really love this vet team :) It’s also fairly easy to make an appointment and schedule around a work schedule. I brought my puppy here from the day she was adopted to now almost 2 years old and they helped me every step of the way :)

I’m a first time dog owner and took my puppy here. I was greeted by the most lovely ladies and was able to ask any and all questions I had. The staff were very understanding and patient with my “first time pet owner” concerns and were just absolutely awesome in general.
Thank you for the 5-star review.

Just want to thank Dr. Andy Henry and the staff at Liberty who took care of my family when we had to put down our Coco last week.  Everyone was so caring; it made the whole process so much better.  Coco spent her last minutes eating peanut butter and left with a smile on her face!! You were all awesome!

Excellent team or caring and understanding doctors and vet techs! Always make it easy and quick to get my babies checked out and treated.  Had an emergency with my dog once and there was no other place I can now imagine taking my dogs in similar situations.

Liberty Veterinary Clinic is the BEST!  When my cat, Frida, stopped eating I took her to another vet that discovered she needed two teeth pulled; but they no longer provided dental surgery.  I learned that many veterinarians don't, and the …

Thank you for taking the time to leave your review rating. We're sorry to hear your experience didn't meet your expectations. Our goal is always to provide the highest standard of care, and we take all concerns seriously. If you would like to discuss this matter further, please reach out to us directly.
